contentHtml:
chicken cordon bleu sandwich is a crispy, cheesy spin on the classic, starring breaded chicken, melted Swiss, and smoky turkey tucked into a soft, toasty bun. A swipe of Dijon, a spoon of garlicky mayo, and fresh veggies add bright, tangy crunch to every bite. Easy to pack for picnics, weeknight-friendly, and worthy of a weekend treat, chicken cordon bleu sandwich delivers comforting flavor and crowd-pleasing vibes. Serve your chicken cordon bleu sandwich with fries, a simple salad, or pickles for a complete, craveable meal.

Why You’ll Love This chicken cordon bleu sandwich

  • Delicious layers of crispy chicken and melty cheese.
  • Quick and easy to prepare for any meal.
  • Perfect for impressing family and friends.
  • Versatile – customize with your favorite toppings!

chicken cordon bleu sandwich

Discover the ultimate chicken cordon bleu sandwich recipe! Crispy, cheesy, and packed with flavor, it’s a must-try for any foodie! 🍗🧀🥪

Prep Time 20 minutes mins
Cook Time 12 minutes mins
resting 3 minutes mins

Servings: 2 servings
Course: Sandwich
Cuisine: American

Ingredients Equipment Method Notes

Ingredients
  

Main Ingredients
  • 2 pieces boneless, skinless chicken breasts Pounded thin.
  • to taste Salt and black pepper For seasoning.
  • 4 slices Swiss cheese For melty goodness.
  • 4 slices ham Feel free to use turkey ham as a substitute.
  • 1 cup breadcrumbs For the crunchy coating.
  • 1/2 cup all-purpose flour For dredging.
  • 2 pieces eggs Beaten, for binding.
  • 2 tablespoons Dijon mustard Adds a tangy kick.
  • 2 tablespoons mayonnaise For creaminess.
  • 1 tablespoon butter For cooking.
  • 2 pieces sandwich rolls or slices of bread Your choice of bread.
Optional Toppings
  • to taste Lettuce leaves For freshness.
  • to taste Tomato slices For freshness.

Equipment

  • 1 Skillet For cooking the sandwich.
  • 3 Bowls For breading station.
  • Toothpicks Toothpicks To secure the rolled chicken.

Method
 

Preparation Steps
  1. Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper. Spread each breast with Dijon mustard for a zesty kick.
  2. Layer each breast with 2 slices of ham and 2 slices of Swiss cheese. This will create a delicious filling.
  3. Roll up each breast tightly and secure with toothpicks. This keeps everything together while cooking.
  4. Set up a breading station: place flour in one bowl, beaten eggs in another, and breadcrumbs in a third. This makes the breading process easy.
  5. Dredge each roll in flour, dip in beaten eggs, then coat with breadcrumbs. This will give your sandwich a crispy exterior.
  6. Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat. Cook rolls until golden brown and cooked through, about 5–6 minutes per side.
  7. Let rolls rest for 3 minutes. Remove toothpicks and slice each roll into thick rounds for easy assembly.
  8. Toast sandwich rolls or bread. Spread with mayonnaise for added flavor.
  9. Assemble sandwiches by layering lettuce, tomato (if using), and sliced chicken cordon bleu. This adds freshness and crunch.
  10. Serve immediately and enjoy your delicious chicken cordon bleu sandwich!

How to Make an Amazing Chicken Cordon Bleu Sandwich

This delightful chicken cordon bleu sandwich is a perfect blend of flavors and textures. With a preparation time of about 20 minutes and a cooking time of 12 minutes, plus an extra 3 minutes for resting, you’ll have a delicious meal ready in no time!

Step 1: Season the Chicken

Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper. Spread each breast with Dijon mustard for a zesty kick.

Step 2: Layer the Ingredients

Layer each breast with 2 slices of ham and 2 slices of Swiss cheese. This will create a delicious filling.

Step 3: Roll and Secure

Roll up each breast tightly and secure with toothpicks. This keeps everything together while cooking.

Step 4: Set Up Breading Station

Set up a breading station: place flour in one bowl, beaten eggs in another, and breadcrumbs in a third. This makes the breading process easy.

Step 5: Dredge the Rolls

Dredge each roll in flour, dip in beaten eggs, then coat with breadcrumbs. This will give your sandwich a crispy exterior.

Step 6: Cook the Rolls

Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat. Cook rolls until golden brown and cooked through, about 5–6 minutes per side.

Step 7: Rest and Slice

Let rolls rest for 3 minutes. Remove toothpicks and slice each roll into thick rounds for easy assembly.

Step 8: Toast the Bread

Toast sandwich rolls or bread. Spread with mayonnaise for added flavor.

Step 9: Assemble the Sandwich

Assemble sandwiches by layering lettuce, tomato (if using), and sliced chicken cordon bleu. This adds freshness and crunch.

Step 10: Serve and Enjoy

Serve immediately and enjoy your delicious chicken cordon bleu sandwich!

Recipe Snapshot

Pro Tips for Making chicken cordon bleu sandwich

  • Choose thinly sliced chicken for even cooking.
  • Use Swiss cheese for a creamy melt.
  • Coat the sandwich in breadcrumbs for extra crunch.
  • Serve with a side of honey mustard for dipping.

How to Serve this chicken cordon bleu sandwich

  • Serve with crispy sweet potato fries for a delightful crunch.
  • Pair with a fresh garden salad drizzled with a tangy vinaigrette.
  • Add a side of creamy coleslaw for a refreshing contrast.
  • Top with a dollop of honey mustard for an extra zing.
  • Enjoy with a side of pickles for a tangy bite.
  • Try it with a light, fruity iced tea to balance the flavors.

Make Ahead and Storage

Here’s how to store your chicken cordon bleu sandwich for later enjoyment:

Storing Leftovers

  • Allow the sandwich to cool completely.
  • Wrap it tightly in plastic wrap or aluminum foil.
  • Place it in an airtight container.
  • Store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

Freezing

  • Wrap the sandwich in plastic wrap, then in foil.
  • Place in a freezer-safe bag or container.
  • Label with the date and freeze for up to 2 months.
  • For best quality, freeze before adding any sauces.

Reheating

  • Thaw in the refrigerator overnight if frozen.
  • Reheat in the oven at 350°F (175°C) for 10-15 minutes.
  • For a quicker option, use a microwave for 1-2 minutes.
  • Check that the center is heated through before serving.

FAQs

Here’s a helpful FAQ about this recipe:

1. What is on the Arby’s chicken cordon bleu sandwich?

The Arby’s chicken cordon bleu sandwich features a crispy chicken fillet, ham, and Swiss cheese, all topped with a creamy mayonnaise-based sauce, served on a toasted bun. It’s a delicious combination of flavors that brings the classic dish into sandwich form!

2. What ingredients are in a traditional chicken cordon bleu sandwich?

A traditional chicken cordon bleu sandwich typically includes breaded and fried chicken breast, slices of ham (or turkey as a substitute), and Swiss cheese. It’s often served with a side of mustard or a creamy sauce, all nestled between two slices of bread or a bun for a hearty meal.

3. How do you assemble a homemade chicken cordon bleu sandwich?

To assemble a homemade chicken cordon bleu sandwich, start by cooking your breaded chicken until golden brown. Then, layer a slice of ham and Swiss cheese on top of the chicken. Place the sandwich on a toasted bun, and add your favorite condiments. You can also include lettuce or tomato for extra freshness!

4. What sauces or condiments pair best with a chicken cordon bleu sandwich?

For a chicken cordon bleu sandwich, creamy sauces like ranch or honey mustard work wonderfully. You can also use a simple mayonnaise or a tangy mustard to enhance the flavors. If you like a bit of heat, a spicy aioli can add a nice kick!

Final Thoughts

Now that you’ve got the scoop on making a delicious chicken cordon bleu sandwich, it’s time to dive in! This dish is not just a meal; it’s a delightful experience that’s simple to whip up and oh-so-rewarding. So gather your ingredients, channel your inner chef, and enjoy every bite of this tasty creation. Happy cooking!
